column4: cleat#2641/#2645, cleat-review's GAP 1: dialect-gated per SUBTEST, one subtest per dialect via testutil.TestDB, same shape as this file's sibling entry for TestAwaitEventClaimsOldestAcrossDialects -- mysql and mssql call t.Skip in this PostgreSQL-only job (CLEAT_TEST_DB only) while postgres RUNS. Opens two claim transactions directly against the real FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED / WITH (UPDLOCK, READPAST, ROWLOCK) statement and asserts they claim different rows. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_DB set: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./plugins/eventtriggers/... -run TestAwaitEventConcurrentClaimsSkipTheLockedRow -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly mysql and mssql, postgres runs.
